summary: Grilled the FORGE-BOARD-7 plan (knacklabs-sanitise-project + update-triggered health cadence), the epic's final story. A machinery map showed doctor/roadmap heal/project audit exist and compose, while three actions need new primitives (crashed-window abandon, standalone stale-state detector, repo-wide secret/cruft scan); the deterministic core is a new forge sanitise composing them. The human refined the CI cadence: remove harness-health.yml's daily cron (token waste) and make the update-check event-driven.
resolutions: Fix-vs-report boundary (the honesty rule): forge sanitise auto-fixes ONLY unambiguously-safe things (roadmap heal, remove tracked cruft) and REPORTS everything needing judgment (board gaps, secrets, stale task-state, open windows, untracked cruft); it never auto-deletes evidence or fabricates (project-record/0025).
One FORGE-BOARD-7 story, 3 tasks (primitives -> forge sanitise command -> skill + cadence + docs) — a tight dependency chain, finishing the epic.

CI cadence: sanitise is on-demand (no scheduled job); harness-health.yml's daily cron is REMOVED and replaced with workflow_dispatch + push:main (client CI events) with a cheap version-compare short-circuit — board-invariant.yml still hard-gates completeness on push:main.
